title: First Physical +Roll Disturbance Closed-Loop Qualification
stage_conclusion: 已验证电机命令与位置反馈链响应正确，但尚未通过肉眼或独立位姿测量确认 Moving Platform 的可见机械补偿运动。
proven_capabilities: Base +Roll is correctly detected by Platform IMU / SO(3)
J8 outputs correct 6-axis negative-Roll step pattern ([-4, 0, +4, +4, 0, -4] steps)
Motor StatusFeedback undergoes corresponding position change following commanded steps
System has no divergence, fault, or watchdog
unproven_capabilities: Visible reverse compensation motion of 6PUS mechanism or Moving Platform has NOT been confirmed
Platform has NOT maintained world attitude invariant
Effective Roll anti-vibration has NOT been achieved
Appreciable disturbance attenuation has NOT been demonstrated
Current +-0.25 deg residual limit is NOT sufficient
physical_observation_and_analysis: User visually observed that when the Base was tilted by approximately +3.6 deg, the Moving Platform visibly followed the Base tilt rather than remaining level, and user did not confirm any visible reverse compensation motion of the mechanism by naked eye. With Base disturbance reaching +3.646 deg and controller residual clamped to -0.25 deg, the commanded differential movement (+-4 steps, ~0.1mm) is below naked-eye visibility threshold against the large manual tilt. The test strictly proves that the command and motor feedback response chain has the correct sign, but visible mechanical compensation and active attitude stabilization performance have not yet been verified or established.
next_stage: J11-3: Roll Disturbance-Rejection Gain / Compensation-Range Tuning
